svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: macOS · Gallery · preview panel on an imported photo (INFO + METADATA from the file) · 1280×800
svg.desc: Mirrors App/GalleryView.swift (macOS branch) + App/GallerySidebar.swift + App/GalleryGridContent.swift + App/GalleryTile.swift + App/GalleryPreviewPanel.swift with App/MetadataPanelSections.swift — the same window as gallery.svg (see its desc for the three-pane layout, the 1280×800 choice, the grid and tab-bar measurements; the sidebar and grid are drawn identically here) with a PHOTO project selected: _WEX3518, the Sony ARW + Lightroom .xmp sidecar of the Milestone 1 test set, imported through Create ▸ Import photos (the import copies; the original is never touched). What changes is the preview panel. Title is the file name, the date line the capture date and file size (31. 8. 2026 · 18,9 MB). The action grid is Open, then Edit · Text · Shapes — no New clip: a Photo capture is one asset. No scope switch for the same reason. INFO (components/metadata-info.photo.narrow.svg) is everything the file said: camera, lens, exposure, captured (in the file's own zone), GPS with the Open in Maps link, size with the format, software. METADATA (components/metadata-fields.file.narrow.svg) is the IPTC Core record with its origins: from file for what the sidecar carried (Caption, Creator, Copyright, Rating 5 — the sidecar wins over the ARW's own 0 — Sublocation, State, Country, Country code), edited here with the revert arrow on Title, which a person retyped in this panel, and no marker on the empty rows. Keywords is the group's last row: the seven dc:subject keywords from the sidecar (components/tag-field.imported.narrow.svg), marked from file; they also seed the project's searchable tags. Below: Storage alone among the metaRows (no AI elements, no field notes yet), the divider and the Rename · Share · Finder · Delete… footer, both ~1.5k pt down and reached by scrolling; no BLENDED CLIPS section, since a Photo project has none. The record itself lives in Projects/<id>/assets.ndjson (one line per asset: bytes, SHA-256, the imported layer, the edited layer with per-field editedAt/editedBy) and metadata.json (the project-level record); edits write the edited layer only. Verified against the running Mac Debug build on a scratch library, 2026-09-13. **2026-09-13, later the same day — TAGS up, PRESETS in (design-first, code owed):** Steven's ruling: tags are the highest-priority metadata a person manages and belong above INFO on every platform, directly under the Open / Edit / Text / Shapes buttons. So the TAGS block comes back out of METADATA to where the 2026-09-08 design had it, and a collapsible PRESETS row follows it. ONE list, ONE editor: tags ARE keywords (Part 2 §4.5 — the manifest's sceneTags that the sidebar, search and the picker read, kept in step with the record's dc:subject that an export writes), so METADATA no longer draws a Keywords row in either scope; the block is always the whole project's, and per-frame keywords a file carried stay stored and exported but are not edited here (settled with Steven 2026-09-13). The origin marker and its revert move with it (10 pt at the header's trailing edge). PRESETS is a 25 pt disclosure row — LLSectionHeader 'PRESETS', then trailing the PresetStatePill (the applied preset's name in LL.accent with white text; Original / Edited on primary 8 % in secondary) and a 12 pt chevron.right — the whole row the button, collapsed by default, its state per panel life. Open (chevron.down), it is the editor's own Presets group verbatim — PhotoAdjustmentsPanel's .rail layout: PresetTile .macGrid in three columns of 85.33×72 at 8 pt, each tile THIS project's hero (AppModel.presetPreviewFrame) rendered through that preset alone at 160 px via PresetThumbnailCache, the applied one ringed — drawn in gallery.presets.svg; a tap applies through AppModel.applyPreset / applyCustomPreset, which keep the project's own rotation, crop and owned white (a preset never carries geometry), after the PresetApplyRequest confirmation when the project is Edited or keyframed. No Save as Preset row, no Lightroom card: nothing is being graded here. A Scanner capture, which presetPreviewFrame excludes, shows no PRESETS row. GEOMETRY: the TAGS block is 21 pt of header plus the field, the PRESETS row 25, the record groups 14 apart as before — so INFO / the scope switch move down by 230 pt, and everything from the metaRows down by 41.5 net (the Keywords row's 229.5 gone, 271 added). The iPad panel follows this file as it always has (same 272 pt column, the Mac's 3-column grid). Implemented and verified the same day (Debug builds: the Mac over a scratch library via -storage.libraryRootPath, the iPhone 17 Pro and iPad Pro 11" M5 simulators; hooks LL_TAB=gallery LL_SELECT=latest|<uuid> and LL_PANEL=presets). Drawn here on Original — an imported photo with nothing applied, the pill in grey — and the sidecar's seven keywords in the TAGS block, 'from file' (tag-field.imported.narrow.svg, 156 tall, which is why INFO moves 230 here against 189 in gallery.svg).
svg.text: macOS · Gallery · grid mode, sidebar + preview · 1280×800 pt window
mirrors App/GalleryView.swift + GallerySidebar + GalleryGridContent + GalleryTile + GalleryPreviewPanel — the 760×680 default window cannot draw this header (see desc)
